The main takeaway from our work is that

, although the TRPM extract elicited a similar pattern of cytokine release from whole blood samples from children with asthma and without asthma, the magnitude of the responses was not identical, with the IL-8 response being most notable.
TRPM exposure may be associated with a diminished capacity to mount an effective IL-8 response to the presence of TRPM, in children with asthma.
